definitions.explanation: A state of wild, uncontrolled excitement or confusion, in a person or in a whole society or market. A written word.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会場|かいじょう}→会場：01269_kaijou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{狂乱|きょうらん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{渦|うず}→渦：01859_uzu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{包|つつ}まれた→包む：01226_tsutsumu⟧。
examples.english: The hall was swept up in a whirl of frenzy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{息子|むすこ}→息子：00799_musuko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行方不明|ゆくえふめい}→行方不明：14039_yukuefumei⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧、⟦{母親|ははおや}→母親：03564_hahaoya⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{半狂乱|はんきょうらん}になった。
examples.english: When she heard her son was missing, the mother became nearly hysterical.

examples.japanese: 1970⟦{年代|ねんだい}→年代：03533_nendai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{石油|せきゆ}→石油：01448_sekiyu⟧⟦{危機|きき}→危機：11798_kiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧あと、⟦{物価|ぶっか}→物価：03607_bukka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{上|あ}がった→上がる：00615_agaru⟧⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧「{狂乱物価|きょうらんぶっか}」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれた→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧。
examples.english: The period of sudden price rises after the 1970s oil crisis was called "crazy prices".

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {半狂乱|はんきょうらん}: half-crazed, nearly hysterical (from shock or grief)
- {狂乱物価|きょうらんぶっか}: runaway inflation (the name for Japan's price surge of 1973–74)
- {狂乱|きょうらん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧: an age of frenzy

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{熱狂|ねっきょう}→熱狂：13479_nekkyou⟧: wild enthusiasm — positive excitement (fans, crowds); {狂乱|きょうらん} is out of control and usually negative
